2267-7084-7272.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least four card types in your graveyard.
You control another nonland creature.
2267-7084-7272.description:
Activate Reaper of Flight Moonsilver by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Reaper of Flight Moonsilver ability.
Activate Reaper of Flight Moonsilver by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Tormod triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Reaper of Flight Moonsilver ability.
Repeat.

2457-4094-4289-8201.easyPrerequisites: At least two loyalty counters on Kaya.
2457-4094-4289-8201.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two creature tokens.
Activate the creature tokens by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat from step 2

3846-7951.easyPrerequisites: You have a noncreature, nonland card in hand with the mana to cast it and valid targets if applicable.
3846-7951.notablePrerequisites: You have at least six cards in hand that have different mana values, excluding the noncreature spell you plan to cast.
3846-7951.description:
Cast the noncreature card by paying its mana cost.
Atemsis triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Atemsis triggers once per opponent, revealing your hand and causing each opponent to lose the game.

uses.n: Invasion of Segovia // Caetus, Sea Tyrant of Segovia

1170-1636-4113-7526.description:
Cast Twofold Intent using Caetus, Sea Tyrant of Segovia's convoke ability by tapping creatures you control.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Quill-Blade Laureate.
When Quill-Blade Laureate enters, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures you control.
Repeat.

1486-2136-2972-4836.notablePrerequisites: Orthion does not have summoning sickness.
1486-2136-2972-4836.description:
Activate Orthion's second ability by paying {6}{R}{R}{R} and tapping it, creating five token copies of Ganax.
When the Ganax tokens enter the battlefield, each Ganax triggers five times, creating 25 Treasure tokens.
Activate Magda by sacrificing five Treasures, searching your library for a Dragon card and putting it onto the battlefield.
When the Dragon enters the battlefield, each Ganax triggers, creating six Treasure tokens.
Repeat from step 3 until you have no Dragons remaining in your library.
1486-2136-2972-4836.notes: This combo will make some extra Treasures which you may use to activate Magda's ability a few extra times to fetch a few artifacts.

2173-2403-2469-5220.description:
Cast Phyrexian Dreadnought from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
When Phyrexian Dreadnought enters, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice it.
When Phyrexian Dreadnought dies, Mortuary and Moonlit Wake trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Phyrexian Dreadnought from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Moonlit Wake trigger, causing you to gain 1 life
Repeat.

5220-5933-6505-6900.description:
Activate Spore Frog by sacrificing it.
When Spore Frog dies, Mortuary and Popular Egotist trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Spore Frog from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Popular Egotist trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Spore Frog ability.
Cast Spore Frog from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

2452-3249-5670-7452--56.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
2452-3249-5670-7452--56.description:
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast a Zombie from your graveyard this turn.
Cast the Zombie from your graveyard by paying {0} due to Rooftop Storm.
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing the Zombie.
When the Zombie dies, Cauldron of Essence triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

27-3259-7296.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
27-3259-7296.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Sun-Blessed Guardian // Furnace-Blessed Conqueror as attackers.
Sun-Blessed Guardian // Furnace-Blessed Conqueror triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

1687-4050-6888.description:
Cast Traveling Plague by paying {3}{B}{B}, attaching it to another creature you control.
When Traveling Plague enters, Siona triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the creature Traveling Plague is attached to.
When the creature dies, Traveling Plague triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the token created in step 2.
When Traveling Plague enters, Siona triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat from step 3.

465-4050-4605-7260.description:
Cast Nature's Rhythm by paying at most {3}{G}{G}{G}{G}, searching your library for Wormfang Drake and putting it onto the battlefield.
When Wormfang Drake enters, it and Preston trigger.
Resolve the Wormfang Drake trigger, exiling another creature if needed.
Resolve the Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Wormfang Drake that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Wormfang Drake token enters, it triggers, exiling the nontoken Wormfang Drake.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Wormfang Drake token
When the Wormfang Drake token dies, it triggers, returning Wormfang Drake from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
465-4050-4605-7260.notes: You can either cast Nature's Rhythm from your hand or for the harmonize cost, adjusting mana requirements accordingly.

2457-4289-6441-7175.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two creature tokens.
Activate the creature tokens by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat

628-6797-7199.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Slumbering Walker.
When Slumbering Walker dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability
Repeat.

527-1409-4885.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {3}{G}{U}.
Activate Selvala by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Selvala enters, Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability triggers, repairing it and Selvala.
Repeat.

717-2894-3022.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
717-2894-3022.description:
Attempt to draw a card. The draw will be replaced by Chains of Mephistopheles, causing you to instead discard Darkblast. Then, you will mill three cards and return Darkblast from your graveyard to your hand due to Darkblast's dredge ability.
Bone Miser's third ability triggers, attempting to have you draw a card. The draw will be replaced by Chains of Mephistopheles, causing you to instead discard Darkblast. Then, you will mill three cards and return Darkblast from your graveyard to your hand due to Darkblast's dredge ability.
Repeat step 2.

1594-3941-4331-4993.description:
Activate Coveted Jewel by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Manifold Key by paying {1} and tapping it, untapping Coveted Jewel.
Activate Drafna's first ability by paying {1}{U}, returning Manifold Key from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Manifold Key by paying {0}.
Repeat.

57-1115-2751-4846.notablePrerequisites: You control any number of permanents that enter untapped and that can collectively tap to produce at least {4}{R}.
57-1115-2751-4846.description:
Activate any number of permanents by tapping them, adding at least {4}{R}.
Activate Feldon by paying {2}{R} and tapping it, targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Holding priority, activate Strionic Resonator by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Feldon's ability targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Resolve the copy of Feldon's ability, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
Resolve the Feldon ability from step 2, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token created in step 4 leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning all cards exiled with it to the battlefield.
Repeat.

671-2919-3490-5231.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
671-2919-3490-5231.description:
Gain life.
Archangel of Thune triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Daxos triggers, causing you to gain life.
Archangel of Thune triggers. Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Servo, adding {R}.
When the Servo dies, Daxos triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve the Archangel of Thune trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control 
Repeat from step 3.

1418-1651-1863-3875-6756.easyPrerequisites: You control a land that enters the battlefield untapped and that can tap to produce at least {1}.
1418-1651-1863-3875-6756.notablePrerequisites: Hearthhull has two or more charge counters on it.
1418-1651-1863-3875-6756.description:
Activate a land by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Hearthhull by paying {1}, tapping it and sacrificing a land.
If Hearthhull has eight or more charge counters on it, it triggers, causing each opponent to lose 2 life.
Resolve the Hearthhull ability, causing you to draw two cards and allowing you to play an additional land this turn.
Play the land from your graveyard.
When the land enters the battlefield, Tireless Provisioner triggers twice due to Virtue of Knowledge, creating two artifact tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the artifact tokens, untapping Hearthhull.
Repeat.

1170-1329-1482-3499.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Jeweled Lotus from your graveyard.
Cast Jeweled Lotus by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Emry.
When Emry enters, it triggers, causing you to mill four cards.
Activate Jeweled Lotus by tapping and sacrificing it.
Repeat.

1479-3585-5700-5701-6763.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1479-3585-5700-5701-6763.description:
Play Petrified Field.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree and Greensleeves trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Echoing Deeps from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Greensleeves trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Echoing Deeps from your hand onto the battlefield untapped as a copy of Petrified Field.
When Echoing Deeps enters the battlefield, Greensleeves triggers.
Holding priority, activate Echoing Deeps using Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Petrified Field from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Greensleeves trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Petrified Field from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Greensleeves triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

2034-2279-5496-6718.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing another creature, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature dies, Extractor Demon triggers, causing you to mill two cards if your graveyard is empty, or causing an opponent to mill two cards otherwise.
If your library is empty, activate Tomb Trawler by paying {2}, putting a card from your graveyard onto the bottom of your library.
Quintorius triggers, creating a 3/2 Spirit creature token.
Repeat.
2034-2279-5496-6718.notes: The combo will grant you an amount of {C} equal to the number of cards in your library, as you do not need to do step 3 as long as your library has cards in it. You can instead also target an opponent in step 2 if your graveyard is not empty.

1651-3715-5365-6627.notablePrerequisites: There is at least one counter on a permanent you control.
1651-3715-5365-6627.description:
Activate Power Conduit by tapping it and removing a counter from a permanent you control, putting two +1/+1 counters on Lonis.
Lonis' second ability triggers, creating two Clue artifact tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the Clues, untapping Power Conduit.
Repeat.

3767-3918-3941-5929.description:
Activate Trazyn using Coveted Jewel's ability by tapping it, adding three mana of any color.
Activate Trazyn by paying {2}, untapping it.
Repeat.

710-4775-5147.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Danitha.
When Danitha dies, Necrogen Communion triggers, returning Danitha from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Danitha enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Necrogen Communion from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Danitha.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

891-2386-5220-5231.notablePrerequisites: Pattern of Rebirth attached to Boonweaver Giant.
891-2386-5220-5231.description:
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing Boonweaver Giant, adding {R}.
When Boonweaver Giant dies, Mortuary and Pattern of Rebirth trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Boonweaver Giant on the bottom of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Pattern of Rebirth trigger, putting Boonweaver Giant from your library onto the battlefield.
When Boonweaver Giant enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Pattern of Rebirth from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Boonweaver Giant.
Repeat.

1329-4222-4808.notablePrerequisites:
Emry does not have summoning sickness.
Freed from the Real attached to Emry.
1329-4222-4808.description:
Activate Black Lotus by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Black Lotus from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Black Lotus by paying {0}.
Activate Freed from the Real's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Emry.
Repeat.

433-654-3478-4222.notablePrerequisites:
Freed from the Real attached to Llanowar Scout.
Llanowar Scout does not have summoning sickness.
433-654-3478-4222.description:
Activate Llanowar Scout by tapping it, putting Dimir Aqueduct onto the battlefield from your hand.
When Dimir Aqueduct enters the battlefield, it and Amulet of Vigor trigger.
Resolve the Amulet of Vigor trigger, untapping Dimir Aqueduct.
Activate Dimir Aqueduct by tapping it, adding {U}{B}.
Resolve the Dimir Aqueduct trigger from step 2, returning it to your hand from the battlefield.
Activate Freed from the Real's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Llanowar Scout.
Repeat.

1636-2034-3621-4331.notablePrerequisites:
Thornbite Staff attached to Drafna.
Drafna does not have summoning sickness.
1636-2034-3621-4331.description:
Cast Su-Chi Cave Guard by paying {8}.
Holding priority, activate Drafna's second ability by paying {3} and tapping it, copying the Su-Chi Cave Guard spell.
Resolve the copy of the Su-Chi Cave Guard spell.
When the Su-Chi Cave Guard token enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Su-Chi Cave Guard token, adding {C}{C}.
When the token Su-Chi Cave Guard dies, it triggers, adding eight {C}.
Repeat from step 2.

1409-2690-4208-4615-4893.description:
Cast Quasiduplicate by paying {1}{U}{U}, creating a token copy of Deadeye Navigator.
The Deadeye Navigator token enters the battlefield, triggering its soulbond ability, pairing it and Ixidron.
Activate Ixidron by paying {U}, blinking it.
All other nontoken creatures you control are turned face-down as Ixidron enters the battlefield.
Ixidron enters the battlefield, triggering the token Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability, repairing Ixidron and the token Deadeye Navigator.
Activate Rattleclaw Mystic's morph ability by paying {1}, turning it face up.
Rattleclaw Mystic triggers, adding {G}{U}{R}.
Repeat from step 3.

1584-2026-4222.notablePrerequisites:
Voyaging Satyr does not have summoning sickness.
Freed from the Real attached to Voyaging Satyr.
1584-2026-4222.description:
Activate Teferi's Isle by tapping it, adding {U}{U}.
Activate Voyaging Satyr by tapping it, untapping Teferi's Isle.
Activate Freed from the Real's last ability by paying {U}, untapping Voyaging Satyr.
Repeat any number of times.
